scope: Independent read-only recomputation of gates 7 and 8 from authenticated real campaign CSV; engineering receipts separately unassessed.

method.implementation: Independent inline Python standard library plus NumPy. No arena imports; no call to arena.universal.analysis.analyze or its helpers; no Torch, environments, checkpoints, gradients, new seeds or rollouts. Frozen sources read as definitions only.
method.bootstrap: 10000 hierarchical paired percentile replicates: resample 3 model replicas, then paired environment seeds within each selected replica; seed 510002 XOR first 8 SHA256 bytes of frozen comparison label, big endian. Same preregistered algorithm and thresholds.
method.action_fraction: For each game, arithmetic mean of the three within-model changed/step fractions. Pixel gate uses environment seeds 920001..920005 only; GRU/world use 920001..920020.
method.performance_pass_rule: mean(shared minus ablation) >= 0 AND percentile CI95 lower bound > 0 AND at least 2/3 model gains strictly > 0; require 2/5 games.
method.world_pass_rule: Mean logged hidden-state MSE_model / mean logged MSE_copy <= 0.95 separately in EVERY one of 5 games x 3 replicas.
method.reward_terminal_metrics: Recomputed MAE from scalar reward_prediction/reward_target_clipped and Brier from terminal_probability/terminated. Compare against TRAIN reward mean/terminal rate, never fit evaluation baseline. Reward MAE/terminal Brier descriptive: frozen analyzer applies its prediction gate to latent ratio only.

coverage.action_pairs_stage_policy_limitation: CSV omits stage/policy columns. Origin is inferred by exact unique step-key join to explicit after_adaptation/shared prediction rows and frozen evaluation producer; no independent stage label exists in action_pairs itself.

consistency.q_mix_definition: 0.8*q_direct + 0.2*model_values; default argmax(q_mixed); world_off argmax(q_direct); first index wins ties.

latent_loss_reconstruction.reason: model_predictions.csv provides scalar latent_mse_model and latent_mse_copy, but not the predicted, actual-next and copied 64-dimensional hidden vectors. This audit independently aggregates recorded per-transition MSEs; it cannot recompute those MSEs from the hidden coordinates. No checkpoint inference was performed.

observation_audit_receipt.reason: Engineering observation audit receipt contents are outside this CSV-only audit. Pixel/GRU arithmetic PASS does not independently certify the input path or issue full gate acceptance.

heldout_provenance_receipt.reason: TRAIN support, distinct training/test seed namespaces, fixed baselines and recorded final shared coverage checked from CSV plus frozen producer source. Independent engineering provenance receipt not reviewed here; per-transition TRAIN clipped rewards absent for Agar.

supported: The real recorded policy is sensitive to same-state pixel and GRU interventions in all five games at preregistered action thresholds.
Paired separate ablation episodes demonstrate preregistered endpoint losses after hiding pixels and resetting GRU in Snake and Flappy, with only three independent trained models.
World model values participate in mixed control and change actions in all five games. This supports computational use of the world branch, not beneficial planning.
Hidden prediction ratio and world-off performance conditions both FAIL. World-off demonstrates no preregistered performance improvement in any of five games.
not_supported: Full gate 7 acceptance from CSV alone; separate observation audit remains unassessed.
World prediction improvement in every game and replica, or a demonstrated world-control performance benefit under the fixed endpoint rule.
Universal gameplay mastery, general Pong mastery, external game transfer or conclusions beyond these five frozen local simulators.
limitations: Exactly one real campaign; no retries or additional scientific interactions were performed.
Only three independent training replicas. Hierarchical bootstrap intervals follow preregistration but remain uncertain.
Same-state intervention sensitivity is not by itself task mastery or a general memory-capacity measurement.
Separate ablation trajectories have different subsequent histories; comparisons are paired by initial environment seed, while action effects are measured on fixed shared states.
Every transition is equally weighted within each game/replica for prediction MSE; episodes have unequal lengths. No post-hoc reweighting or favorable-game selection.
Reward MAE and terminal Brier comparisons use fixed TRAIN baselines and are reported even where negative; neither is silently promoted to a new acceptance threshold.
TRAIN clipped reward mean reconstructs for 12/15 game/replica cells from aggregate CSV plus frozen reward formulas; Agar 3/15 is specifically NOT_EVIDENCED at raw clipping reconstruction level.
